scope: Independent same-data, same-config, same-environment CPU review of reconstructed local pipeline; historical Colab results cannot be reproduced without their source and historical membership.

reason: Same pinned software, same single-thread CPU histogram XGBoost, controlled seeds and input order should be exactly deterministic. Any discrepancy fails this scope and must be investigated; no tolerance will be silently loosened.
